images.name: storm-hawk-bg-v3.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone opaque background layer, storm-hawk-bg-v3.png, for the card "Storm Hawk".
Output: PNG, exactly 1280x1024 pixels, 5:4 landscape aspect ratio.

STYLE:
Hand-painted gouache illustration with confident, visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain. Composition borrows from Japanese woodblock prints: bold silhouette, strong diagonal, generous negative space, flat layered planes of color. Series rules shared by every card: night or low light, a dark low-key background, a creature clearly lighter than its background, and warm gold (#f6cf6a) rim light along the creature's top edges. This card's own palette (use these colors, not purple or lavender): storm slate (#1a2633), deep steel blue (#2f4d6b), rain grey-blue (#8aa3b8), white feather (#f2f4f6), lightning gold (#f6cf6a). One clear light source, no lens flare. Shapes are simplified and graphic, not photoreal. Feels like a printed storybook plate.

SCENE:
Night storm over high mountains. The sky is dark storm slate shading to deep steel blue near the horizon through flat painted tonal planes. Heavy thunderheads as flat, layered woodblock shapes in steel blue, lit only along their top edges by thin rain grey-blue rim light. Slanted streaks of rain in the far distance. One thin gold lightning fork far in the distance on the right, small and quiet: the only light source. Lower third: near-black slate ridges with a soft band of grey mist between them. Upper left is calm, empty dark sky. No animals or figures.

COMPOSITION AND VALUES:
Dark and low-key, about 75% dark values, so a white and gold hawk placed over it later stands out strongly. Keep the upper-left and center very dark. Full-bleed, no border. Do not render the hawk.

AVOID:
photorealism, 3D render look, glossy shading, airbrushed smooth gradients, HDR glow everywhere, bokeh, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures, purple or lavender color cast. No bright daytime sky, no large pale cloud faces, no animals or figures.

images.name: storm-hawk-fg-v2.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: isolated foreground creature layer, storm-hawk-fg-v2.png, for the card "Storm Hawk".
Output: PNG, exactly 1280x1024 pixels, 5:4 landscape aspect ratio, genuine transparent alpha background.

STYLE:
Hand-painted gouache illustration with confident, visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain. Composition borrows from Japanese woodblock prints: bold silhouette, strong diagonal, generous negative space, flat layered planes of color. Series rules shared by every card: night or low light, a dark low-key background, a creature clearly lighter than its background, and warm gold (#f6cf6a) rim light along the creature's top edges. This card's own palette (use these colors, not purple or lavender): storm slate (#1a2633), deep steel blue (#2f4d6b), rain grey-blue (#8aa3b8), white feather (#f2f4f6), lightning gold (#f6cf6a). One clear light source, no lens flare. Shapes are simplified and graphic, not photoreal. Feels like a printed storybook plate.

SUBJECT:
A fierce hawk mid-dive along a strong diagonal from upper left to lower right, wings swept back in a sharp crescent, talons forward. Feathers in white and rain grey-blue with steel-blue barring, simplified into a few bold painted shapes, so the bird is much lighter than a dark storm sky. Gold catches the leading edge of the wings like rim light from lightning. Small crackles of gold static trail off the wingtips. The eye is a single bright gold point, hooked beak in gold.

COMPOSITION:
The hawk fills about 60% of the frame, cropped slightly by the right edge for energy. Strong asymmetric silhouette, head and talons directed toward lower right, two wings swept back toward upper left. Keep the talons above the bottom 10% of the frame. Anatomically coherent single hawk with two wings and two legs. The silhouette must read clearly at thumbnail size (about 150 pixels wide).

CONSTRAINTS:
Isolated on a fully transparent background, clean alpha edges, no ground, no sky, no shadow, no backdrop color or paper rectangle. Paper grain and painted texture only inside the hawk silhouette. Preserve transparency around the gold static. Do not paint a checkerboard.

AVOID:
photorealism, 3D render look, glossy plastic shading, airbrushed smooth gradients, over-detailed feathers, HDR glow everywhere, centered symmetrical pose, bokeh, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures, extra limbs, warped anatomy, purple or lavender color cast, real-world national emblem or eagle crest look.
